description: Presidential Secretariat - Duities and Functions Amendment to the Gazette Extra Ordinary No.2289/43 of 22.07.2022.
reasoning: This gazette notification amends ministerial portfolios and responsibilities (specifically for the Minister of Defence, Minister of Women, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment, and Minister of Education) by naming specific subject areas and responsibilities. It is issued by and names President Ranil Wickremesinghe, making it a Hybrid Gazette that contains both government personnel (the President) and detailed portfolio responsibilities.
